brief: A contacts app as a social constellation — closeness reflects relationship, interactions glow

dominant_strengths: Strong metaphor execution — glowing nodes on black evoke an actual constellation, with proximity meaningfully encoding closeness
Color-coded relationship categories paired with neon glow create instant emotional read and clear legend mapping
Composition feels organic, not gridded; varying node sizes and faint connection lines communicate intimacy hierarchy
dominant_weaknesses: Initials-only labels create heavy cognitive load — users must memorize 15+ two-letter codes with no hover/name affordance shown
Top-right buttons are generic system chrome that clash with the cosmic metaphor; feels bolted-on rather than integrated
Faint connection lines are nearly invisible, undermining the relational graph that's the whole point of the visualization
fix_priorities: Replace initials with full first names or progressive disclosure on hover/zoom to make the graph actually usable
Strengthen edge visibility with weighted glow lines reflecting interaction recency, fulfilling the 'interactions glow' brief
Redesign top chrome to match the constellation language — minimal icons, perhaps a starfield-aware toolbar
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral and reflective dominate via the striking metaphor, but behavioral usability suffers from cryptic initials and weak edges.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures the constellation poetry beautifully but only half-delivers on 'interactions glow' since edges and recency aren't visually active.
